title: Operators and Control Flow
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Operators and Control Flow and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 5: Operators and Control Flow; it lists all 11 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 5 roadmap: Arithmetic Operators; Comparison and Equality Operators; Logical Operators; Bitwise and Shift Operators; Assignment and Compound Assignment; Operator Precedence and Expression Evaluation; if , else if , and else; for and while Loops; do-while Loops and Loop Control; break , continue , and Nested Loops; Checked Arithmetic, unchecked Blocks, and Overflow Behavior. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
